description: Send a pickup order to another store, as the pickup monitor's transfer does: its stock reservation moves to the new store's warehouse, its pick and ship lists are rebuilt there, its pickup position is cleared and it gets a new pickup code. The preview lists any line the new store cannot cover; to transfer anyway as a backorder, set acceptShortfall=true. The customer is not messaged. Automation rules on order transfers apply. Requires Write + pickup.execute; operator credentials only. Preview first, then repeat identical arguments with previewReceipt and idempotencyKey. In-app assistants get a confirm card.

acceptShortfall.description: true transfers even when the new store cannot cover every line (they backorder).

order.description: Pickup order id, order number or pickup code.

targetStore.description: The store to send it to: id, code or name.

name: transfer_pickup_order
title: Transfer Pickup Order
